geometry: 14 by 14 canvas with a nearly square translucent black background and a single smooth, round-capped sine-like Bézier stroke. The source stroke occupies approximately x=2–12 and y=3–11 pixels; the background alpha is 166/255 across the interior.
limitations: The original is a small antialiased raster; the curve and corner antialiasing are approximated with smooth vector geometry. Native and 8x SVG renders were visually inspected.
